messages:
Maria: bumping v1.12.0 -> v1.12.1 now, noticed the zipped artifacts on S3 differ from GH draft. can someone sanity-check checksums?
Ajay: ok I'll run the smoke upload and checksum compare now
Maria: thanks - I pushed tag annotated 'v1.12.1-rc.1' earlier but then had to repackage. maybe a stray artifact on ci-storage
Kyle: @Maria can you paste the git tag command you used? want to make sure annotated vs lightweight
Maria: ran:
```
git tag -a v1.12.1 -m "release v1.12.1"
git push origin refs/tags/v1.12.1
```
Maria: release-bot created draft release but assets show mismatched size
release-bot: Draft release created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.12.1 (ci: artifact-upload v2)
Ajay: hitting the runner logs now, looks like the makerelease job uploaded both tar.gz and zip; checking sha256...
Kyle: if the annotated tag was created after the upload GH may have linked prior assets. simplest is retag + dry-run: delete tag locally+remote, re-tag, push, then rerun upload job.
Maria: ok plan: 1) delete remote tag, 2) create annotated tag with correct commit, 3) trigger ci:makerelease:upload-drafts
Ajay: I'll coordinate the CI rerun (canary upload) and confirm checksums. ping me when you delete remote tag
Maria: done: `git push --delete origin v1.12.1`
Maria: re-created annotated tag at correct commit and pushed
Maria: `git push origin refs/tags/v1.12.1`
release-bot: Retag detected for v1.12.1 — re-running makerelease workflow
Ajay: CI shows new upload finished, sha256s match `3b2f...c9a7`. looks good. can we update changelog entry to add the packaging note?
Maria: added line under v1.12.1: "Fix: packaging mismatch resolved; ensured annotated tag used for artifacts." pushed changelog bump to release branch
Kyle: ok will finalize the draft release notes and mark ready for publish. no further holds from me :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks team, will wait for final signoff then publish
